entities.name: Query dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: 199-aa soluble protein sequence; predicted molecular mass 20.5 kDa and pI 4.99.
Has 78.8–79.4% identity and 99.5% query coverage to reviewed mycobacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Function is strongly inferred as EC 3.6.1.66 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase.
Homolog annotations report cytosolic localization and Mg2+ binding, one Mg2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: dITP + H2O = dIMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28342.
This is a candidate reaction assigned from highly similar reviewed homologs.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O = XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.
This is a candidate reaction assigned from highly similar reviewed homologs.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: ITP + H2O = IMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:29399.
This is a candidate reaction assigned from highly similar reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Nucleotide pool sanitization
observations: The enzyme is proposed to remove noncanonical purine nucleotides from the nucleotide pool, reducing their incorporation into DNA or RNA and possible chromosomal lesions.
The precise relative substrate preference of the query sequence is inferred from homologs rather than directly measured.
